_note: Heuristic v1 parameters. These are MVP engineering choices, not scientifically validated coefficients. Review with agronomists before operational use.

vegetation._note: stress = clip(-ndvi_anomaly_pct / full_stress_anomaly_pct, 0, 1). Positive anomalies give zero stress.

water._note: Water component = max of the available sub-signals. water_balance_14d = sum(precipitation) - sum(ET0); an environmental water-balance indicator, not a measurement of plant water stress.

seasonal._note: Used when a past-only seasonal climatology is available (median of prior years at the same date, same location). Water stress is then scored on the deficit RELATIVE TO THE SEASONAL NORM, so a normal post-monsoon dry period is not flagged. Absolute thresholds above are the fallback.

heat._note: Heat component = max of the available sub-signals.

soil._note: Only used when a soil record is marked verified. Severity per classification status; constraint parameters (pH, EC) use their own severity when abnormal.

insufficient_evidence._note: Risk classification is withheld when evidence quality is below this score, or when too little of the nominal weight is backed by data.
